reply_text:
I replied to Pree in a thread on her #central-team message. I couldn't confirm the 8 April renewal date, so I didn't record it anywhere.

- **What I checked:** #central-team and the public Central team files, all of which Pree can see. None of them mention Brackenwater Freight Co. or a renewal date for it.
- **Knowledge brain:** gbrain refused the search and read nothing. Its access token isn't tied to any member, and it serves several people. Whoever runs the gbrain server needs to run `gbrain auth rescope --token <token> --member <MEMBER>`. A shared bot like this one can instead be set up to name, on each request, the member it's acting for. I didn't try to get around this or use other routes like `search_messages`. Those could show Pree things she can't see herself.
- **What I told Pree:** to get the date confirmed in writing from the Brackenwater contact, or from the contract through the account owner. Once she posts the confirmed date, I'll take it from there.
